en.intro: User manual for the [3x-ui](https://github.com/MHSanaei/3x-ui) panel — a comprehensive user guide written for panel **v3.6.0**.
en.mirrorNote: **Read-only mirror.** This GitHub repository is a one-way mirror — the manual's source lives in a private GitLab and is pushed here automatically, so it's always up to date. Found an error or inaccuracy? Please [open an Issue](https://github.com/yukh975/3X-UI-Manual/issues). **Pull requests are not accepted** (they're closed automatically) — fixes are made at the source.
en.footer: Created from an analysis of the panel's source files. Yuriy Khachaturian ([yukh.net](https://yukh.net))
